findings.finding: Worker lifecycle and genuine SIGINT lease-recovery evidence agree: shutdown stops new claims, terminates the owned provider tree, preserves the active job for recovery, and a restart completes it without duplicate effects.
The active-provider deadline, resource-wait deadline, and post-terminal crash seam are represented by real Windows harness evidence with bounded cleanup and duplicate-free durable effects.

Capacity states, FIFO control-plane behavior, retry interpretation, review-conflict adjudication, additive laterality correction, prompt-safety handling, and truthful deletion retention wording are covered by source checks and committed evidence.

limitations: This is an engineering evidence audit, not clinical validation, regulatory review, or model-performance sign-off.
The independent audit records code and committed evidence; it does not re-run the long provider harnesses.
The current implementation-head CI run must be re-observed after this artifact is pushed; report-head CI is a separate post-report verification gate.
